goldInvestment.title: Real-Time Gold Investment Tracking System
goldInvestment.description: Automated Notion dashboard with live gold price API integration and automated profit & ROI calculation.
goldInvestment.content:
If you're manually tracking gold investments and calculating profits by hand, this case study shows how a fully automated **Gold Investment Tracking System in Notion** can bring real-time clarity to your portfolio.

---

## Project Overview

- **Client Type:** Individual Investor
- **Location:** Egyptian investor based in Saudi Arabia
- **Scope:** Custom Real-Time Gold Portfolio Dashboard
- **Tools Used:** Notion · Gold Price API · Google Apps Script
- **Date:** 1FEB 2026

---

## The Challenge: Manual Gold Tracking & Repetitive Calculations

The client invests in physical gold and needed to track:

- Live gold price per gram
- Value of owned weights (5g, 10g, etc.)
- Purchase price vs. current value
- Profit or loss
- ROI percentage
- Multi-currency pricing (USD, SAR, EGP)

Before the system:

- He checked gold prices online daily
- Calculated portfolio value manually
- Computed profit and percentage returns by hand
- Repeated the process every time the price changed

This method was time-consuming and error-prone.

He needed a **real-time gold investment tracker inside Notion**.

---

## The Solution: Notion + Gold Price API Integration

To eliminate manual calculations, we built a custom **Notion investment tracking system** powered by automation.

### Live Gold Price in Notion

We connected Notion to a **Gold Price API** using:

- Custom Notion Integration
- Google Apps Script (middleware automation)
- Scheduled update logic

The system automatically updates:

- Live price per gram
- Live price per ounce
- USD, SAR, and EGP conversions

This allows global market monitoring directly inside Notion.

---

### Gold Portfolio Tracking Database

We created a second database to manage:

- Weight owned (grams / ounce)
- Buy date
- Buy price per gram
- Total purchase value

This database is dynamically linked to the live price database to automatically calculate:

- Current value
- Total portfolio value
- Net profit or loss
- ROI percentage

All calculations update instantly when gold prices change.

---

## Smart Purchase Logging System

To simplify daily usage, we implemented one-click action buttons.

With a single click, the system:

- Captures the live gold price
- Multiplies by selected weight
- Logs purchase details
- Records transaction date
- Adds entry to the portfolio database

No manual price copying.

No spreadsheet formulas.

No recalculations.

---

## System Features

### Real-Time Gold Price Tracking in Notion

Live API-powered price updates.

### Automated Gold Profit Calculator

Dynamic calculation of gains, losses, and ROI.

### Multi-Currency Investment Monitoring

Track performance in USD, SAR, and EGP.

### Structured Investment Dashboard

Clear portfolio overview in one centralized system.

resaltk.title: Resaltk – Research App Project Management System
resaltk.description: Streamlined Notion dashboard for managing research app development with tasks, ideas, meetings, people, and documents.
resaltk.content:
Streamlined Notion dashboard for managing research app development with tasks, ideas, meetings, people, and documents.

**Client Type:** Mobile App

**Scope:** Custom Notion System to plan, track, and execute app development

**Tools Used:** Notion

---

## The Challenge

The client, a professor, wanted to develop a mobile application for **master's, PhD, and research enthusiasts**.

Challenges included:

- Managing multiple ideas, tasks, and priorities
- Tracking meetings with outcomes and action points
- Maintaining contacts, roles, and communication with collaborators
- Organizing documents, links, and research resources
- Coordinating multiple moving parts without losing clarity

Before the system:

- The client used scattered spreadsheets and notes
- Lost time consolidating tasks and ideas
- Had difficulty tracking project progress

They needed a **centralized system** to plan, organize, and monitor the entire app development workflow.

---

## The Solution: Integrated Notion System

We designed a **custom Notion workspace** that integrates six key databases:

### Tasks

- Track tasks and recurring tasks
- Set priority, start/end date, and due date
- Clear status monitoring

### Ideas

- Quick notes and in-action ideas
- Categorization by status and type
- Link ideas to tasks with one click
- Track progress of each idea

### People

- Track collaborators, roles, and relationships
- Fields for name, contact info, account, university, college, field, workplace, CV
- Centralized communication and accountability

### Places

- Track locations, contact details, and services
- Relationship type and pricing info

### Meetings

- Track date, time, mode (online/offline), and outcomes
- Record meeting goals and follow-ups

### Documents

- Store files or links, with date and description
- Central reference for research materials

---

### Dashboard Overview

All databases are interlinked:

- Ideas can be sent to Tasks with one click
- Meetings reference People and Places
- Documents link to tasks, meetings, and ideas
- Central dashboard provides a **full project overview at a glance**

---

## The Outcome

After implementation:

- The client has **complete visibility** over app development
- Tasks, ideas, meetings, and documents are **fully organized**
- Priorities and deadlines are clear
- Project progress can be tracked in **real time**
- Collaboration with multiple stakeholders is simplified

The system eliminates scattered notes, spreadsheets, and lost information, replacing them with a **centralized, automated, and scalable Notion workspace**.

trendDesign.title: Trend Design – Notion Operating System for an Interior Design Company
trendDesign.description: A fully integrated Notion system managing projects, clients, design, finance, sales, HR, and company operations in one centralized workspace.
trendDesign.content:
A fully integrated Notion system managing projects, clients, design, finance, sales, HR, and company operations in one centralized workspace.

**Client:** Trend Design

**Industry:** Interior Design

**Location:** Saudi Arabia

**Scope:** Full Company Operations System

**Platform:** Notion

---

## The Challenge

Trend Design is a Saudi interior design company managing:

- Multiple active projects
- Clients with different scopes and budgets
- Internal design workflows
- Financial tracking
- Sales and marketing activities
- HR and team coordination

Before the system:

- Data was scattered across tools
- Departments operated separately
- Project status lacked real-time visibility
- Financial tracking wasn't fully centralized
- Management decisions required manual follow-ups

They needed a **centralized, scalable operating system** to connect all departments and provide leadership with clarity.

---

## The Solution: A Complete Notion Business Operating System

We built a fully interconnected workspace with more than 10 relational databases, turning Notion into the company's internal operating system.

---

# Core System Architecture

## Projects Database

The central backbone of the system.

Includes:

- Project name
- Area (sqm)
- Location
- Project cost
- Status (Pipeline / Approved / In Design / In Execution / Completed)
- Linked Client
- Linked Financials
- Linked Design Tasks

This database connects every department.

---

## Clients Database

Tracks:

- Client contact information
- Related projects
- Communication records
- Client classification

Management can instantly see:

- Total projects per client
- Project value
- Relationship status

---

## Project Management (Approval Workflow)

This database handles pre-execution decisions.

Includes:

- Study status
- Cost estimation
- Pricing analysis
- Approval decision

Workflow logic:

If approved →

Automatically sent to the Design Department with structured task setup.

This ensures a controlled transition from evaluation to execution.

---

## Design Department System

When a project is approved:

- Design tasks are automatically generated
- Assigned engineer is linked
- Timeline is defined
- Status is tracked

The design team works within a structured task environment directly linked to the original project.

No manual coordination required.

---

## Finance System

Tracks:

- Company expenses
- Project-based direct costs
- Indirect operational expenses
- Invoices

Linked to projects for:

- Real-time cost visibility
- Profit tracking per project
- Financial clarity for management

---

# Supporting Departments

To centralize company operations, we built additional databases for:

### Sales

Lead tracking, pipeline, deal status.

### PR

Partnerships, public relations tracking.

### HR

Team data, roles, employment details.

### Marketing

Campaign tracking, strategies, execution status.

### Content

Content planning and production tracking.

### Meetings

Meeting date, participants, decisions, and action items  linked to projects and departments.

---

# Dashboard & Visibility

All databases are relationally connected.

Management Dashboard provides:

- Active projects overview
- Financial snapshot
- Department performance
- Pending approvals
- Design workload
- Sales pipeline

Everything connected.

Everything structured.

Everything visible.
